title: MetaStays
tagline: The Web3 Airbnb. Book your next stay with crypto, hassle-free transactions, verified listings, and like-minded connections
description: MetaStays is a web3 property marketplace that enables users to book housing with crypto and social graph. It allows for short-term rentals to be more secure, convenient, and social. MetaStays is the evolution of short-term rentals, offering transparency, efficiency and security. Mint accommodations as NFTs with Unlock, trust your landlords and tenants with Worldcoin’s WorldID, and review your MetaStay using Lens social media integration.
how_its_made:
MetaStays is a web3 platform that allows users to book and manage housing using their Lens profile. Once users connect their Lens profile, they can book a stay or manage their properties. The "Book Housing" page allows users to search for properties and view their details. If they like a property, they can "Mint the Key" to rent it. The "Manage Properties" page allows users to list their properties and manage their bookings via Unlock.

MetaStays' most relevant features are: 

* Seamless WalletConnect Integration: Easily check if your wallet is linked to a Lens handle, ensuring smooth and secure transactions.

* Verified Listings and Community-Driven Reviews: Connect with like-minded travelers and hosts on Lens, our integrated web3 social platform. Share your experiences and make informed decisions!

* Pay with Crypto: Experience hassle-free transactions using your favorite cryptocurrencies. Say goodbye to traditional payment methods, with Unlock.
